module: Editor ImGui widget to choose a light color temperature in Kelvin, with presets (candle, sodium, LED, xenon...), filament type and degradation. Used by light inspectors. The module also converts a Kelvin value to linear RGB (approximation of the Planckian locus, Rec.709/sRGB D65).
usage:
local r, g, b = editor_api_colorTemperatureUI.kelvinToRGBLinear(3200)
local s = editor_api_colorTemperatureUI.kelvinToColorStringLinear(3200, 1) -- "r g b a"
notes: Kelvin clamped to 1667..25000 in kelvinToRGBLinear; default 6500 if nil.
The returned RGB is normalized (the max component equals 1) and negative values are brought back to 0.
The UI state (Kelvin, preset, filament, degradation) is kept by id in local tables of the module.

draw.desc: Draws the widget (Kelvin slider, presets, filament type combo, degradation slider if the filament has one). Values go through the opts callbacks: getKelvin(), setKelvin(k, isFinal), getRGBA(), setRGBA(r,g,b,a,isFinal), getFilamentId(), setFilamentId(id, isFinal), getDegradation(), setDegradation(v, isFinal).

opts.desc: id (string, default "kelvin"), label (default "Color temperature"), minK/maxK (default 1000..20000) and the get/set callbacks above. isFinal is true at the end of an edit.

kelvinToRGBLinear.desc: Converts a color temperature to normalized linear RGB (max = 1).

k.desc: Temperature in Kelvin, clamped to 1667..25000 (6500 if nil)

kelvinToColorStringLinear.desc: Like kelvinToRGBLinear but returns the string "r g b a" (6 decimals), the color format of object fields.
